properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (root-cause skill, 2026-10-24): a limit each part meets on its own (a setback, a clearance) could only be recorded as a budget its parts spend together, so short parts summed to "within", an unmeasured part could never break a minimum, and an empty minimum read "exceeded"
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (fetched fresh), 2026-10-24, on item B3 of the hub's fact:shop-sample-trial-friction-2026-10-24 (Anthony's design 671a764fa790c030, reflow2 0.91.0).

① OBSERVED: budget_report swept 21 limits, 18 within, 3 incomplete. The 100 ft well limit read within on 102.36 while the barn lean-to was recorded elsewhere at 12 ft; its CONSTRAINS edge carried no number. The agent's report: "a minimum-distance constraint with no contributions reads 'fails: budget exceeded', and distances do not add, so the agent recorded only the nearest part's distance (a workaround). A numeric limit cannot be cleared once set (limit: null is ignored)." NOT AFFECTED: true sums (lot coverage, areas add).

② PRECEDENT: fact:root-cause-a-latency-budget-with-parallel-branches-is-judged-on-the-sum-while-its-worst-path-is-computed-beside-it-2026-09-29 gave composition sum|path; its idea's five options never held a per-part bound. chg:eight-field-feedback-fixes-land-for-v0510 settled "null unsets" for create_node only. Nothing in the 26 designs the hub reaches held a per-part limit.

③-⑤ CANDIDATES, each with the measurement that could refute it (probes on main 61c05ad74):
(A) VOCABULARY: COMPOSITIONS = [sum, path], path refuses a minimum; two 6 ft parts against a 10 ft minimum read within (12); the barn's 12 ft recorded read within (114.36). HOLDS.
(B) EMPTY MINIMUM: read exceeded (total -0), an empty maximum within. HOLDS, but it is A's sum rule on a clearance; not separable from A.
(C) ROUTING, outside the budget code: capture-intent's row for "a number with a unit" said "constrains each spender with its contribution" and named no per-part limit. Holds as a contributor; EnvironmentRule judges no number, and a VIOLATES_RULE ruled rejected left the gap list while unfixed.
(D) limit: null: the typed request takes an optional number, null equals absent, upsert merges; the limit survived. HOLDS, a separate class (a settled rule reached one door).
(E) THE OBSERVATION IS WRONG: refuted, the report matched the code.

⑥ CLASS: reflow2's only numeric limit was a budget the parts spend together; a limit each part meets on its own (setbacks, clearances, separation distances, each unit against its own area table value, as in SeattleArch) was forced into it. Fixed by dec:a-limit-each-part-meets-on-its-own-is-composition-each and dec:a-minimum-nothing-has-measured-reads-incomplete; D by dec:null-unsets-on-every-typed-constructor, not built yet.

⑦ PINNED: crates/reflow2-core/tests/a_limit_each_part_meets_on_its_own.rs, observed failing first (930a6c489).

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED: per-pair bounds where both ends move (option b) were not needed by this case and are not built.
